_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 7-10 September 2025: the BC earthquake with a death toll, the cancer cure, the pillars.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw cells throughout America of people who had come across the border, replaying like a film in fast forward.
mentions.quote: I saw cells all throughout America of people that had come across
mentions.falsify_match: Networks of hostile border crossers uncovered across the United States.

mentions.claim_text: He says the mother hen, which was China, is trying to scoop them up and influence them close, and reports the Lord saying to pray for the influence of Japan as a strategic ally.
mentions.quote: trying to bring them close to the mother hen, which was China
mentions.falsify_match: Regional states drawn into the Chinese orbit while Japan holds.

mentions.claim_text: Prompted by a question he says he saw the Canadian prime minister but that he did not look like he knew how to lead and was just trying.
mentions.quote: he did not look like he knew how to lead
mentions.falsify_match: Visible failure of leadership by the Canadian prime minister.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A character judgment on a named leader with no test attached, and the subject was prompted by someone in the room.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they will go along and stay buddies across the water with Europe and its agenda, separated from American thinking.
mentions.quote: Staying buddies with you all across the water into Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Canada aligning with Europe against American policy.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether he saw the plague again, he says no, not that day.
mentions.quote: No, I did not see the plague again
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a negative answer to a viewer question, worth keeping because he declines to add to the plague material when invited.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know why but he saw something about the supply chain escalating, and that it was about pharmaceuticals again.
mentions.quote: something with the escalation of the supply chain but it was about pharmaceuticals
mentions.falsify_match: A pharmaceutical supply chain disruption in the United States.

mentions.claim_text: He says it stretched from Louisiana across the south and he does not know what it was about, but that Louisiana and Mississippi were the states highlighted most.
mentions.quote: going from Louisiana all across the south
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event running across the Gulf south from Louisiana.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states he does not know what it is about.

mentions.claim_text: He notes people have discredited a man as not radical enough, and reports the Lord saying he is going to use this place for a plan.
mentions.quote: I am going to use this place for a plan
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: neither the man nor the place is named.

mentions.claim_text: He compares a colour he saw on medals to the purple of an American Purple Heart awarded for wounds in war.
mentions.quote: that is the kind of purple that was on some of these medals
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a colour comparison inside a vision.

mentions.claim_text: He remarks on the signs of the times in the Middle East, saying they will see signs in the heavens and signs in the earth.
mentions.quote: signs in the heavens, signs in the earth
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a general framing from Luke 21.

mentions.claim_text: He says the point is to desensitise people, and notes the objection that billions or trillions would be lost in cancer treatments.
mentions.quote: they will lose billions of dollars in cancer treatments
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an objection restated ahead of the cure claim.

mentions.claim_text: He responds to a claim that a cure for cancer exists by saying that will not stand and asking where America is, and says he knows there is one because he has seen it suppressed and held back.
mentions.quote: I know we have one because I have seen it being suppressed
mentions.falsify_match: A suppressed cancer cure released or exposed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Cancer is many diseases rather than one, so a single suppressed cure is not a coherent object, and the claim would require every oncologist to be complicit.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether it will come from Russia and be triggered in America, says he does not know and it is something to watch, and finds it interesting that what was said in prayer is coming out in the natural.
mentions.quote: will it come from Russia and trigger it in America? I do not know
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian medical breakthrough adopted in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Posed as a question he says he cannot answer.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a social media post about India and corrects himself over which platform it was, remarking there are too many platforms.
mentions.quote: his truth social of saying it looks like India
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a post read out.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man paddling his canoe and struggling as he goes over the waterfall, and reports the Lord saying that as America lines up with Israel it will be an extension of grace and the Abrahamic blessing.
mentions.quote: As America lines up with Israel, it will be an extension of my grace
mentions.falsify_match: Visible benefit to America conditional on its Israel policy.
mentions.falsify_miss: None attributable. Grace has no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the two-state solution discussions are set for the 23rd and 24th for Israel and calls it a very important week.
mentions.quote: discussions are supposed to be on the 23rd and the 24th
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the UN high-level week dates read off the published calendar, which is where the September dates in this corpus come from.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Canada going with the two-state solution and prays it does not, and that he saw British Columbia have the worst earthquake in history with 30,000 people perishing that day on the coastline.
mentions.quote: the worst earthquake in history of 30,000 people perish that day
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake killing about 30,000 on the British Columbia coast, tied to Canadian recognition of Palestine.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such quake. Canada recognised Palestinian statehood on 21 September 2025 and no earthquake followed. This is the one place the BC quake carries a death toll, which makes it the scoreable version.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not about America because there are only 350 million people here, and that he is believing for the whole world to have a major outpouring.
mentions.quote: There is only 350 million people here
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a scale argument. The US population is about 342 million, so the figure is close.

mentions.claim_text: He says Israel was highlighted immediately and he saw Jerusalem again instantaneously.
mentions.quote: I saw Jerusalem again and instantaneously I saw this
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a place seen, with the content broken off.

mentions.claim_text: He covers the nation, Israel, Jerusalem and the people, and prays peace over both areas, the cities, Washington DC and the main areas of business.
mentions.quote: We cover our nation. We cover Israel. We cover Jerusalem
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a covering petition.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying they will see a revival like never before from shore to shore, and repeats a harvest in America three times.
mentions.quote: You are going to see a revival like you have never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: A revival in America exceeding any previously recorded.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A superlative with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says revival will break out on live streams including Facebook, similar to what they are doing now, and calls them Holy Ghost movements.
mentions.quote: on live streams, revival breaking out similar to what we are doing
mentions.falsify_match: Revival movements originating on streaming platforms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note that this places his own broadcast inside the thing being foretold.

mentions.claim_text: He says no nation will be left out, naming Asia, Africa and Europe, and that some will have to resist it and say they do not want this in their church.
mentions.quote: no nation will be left out. You will have to resist it
mentions.falsify_match: A revival reaching every nation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Framed so that resistance to it is also confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they are there and part of it, and describes trying to reason out how a vision will come about.
mentions.quote: how you try to see when you are looking at vision
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a reflection on interpreting visions.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were trying to back their currency and make it digital with certain oil arrangements to get out from under Western sanctions and their stipulations.
mentions.quote: trying to back their currency, to make it digital
mentions.falsify_match: A commodity-backed digital currency launched to evade sanctions.

mentions.claim_text: He says the gospel will be preached throughout the whole world and then they will come, speaking of all Asia.
mentions.quote: we would preach the gospel throughout the whole world, then they will come
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the Matthew 24 precondition restated.

mentions.claim_text: He says the atmosphere is charged and points to his warnings about Venezuela and Cuba, and that an olive branch of peace is going out.
mentions.quote: An olive branch of peace is going
mentions.falsify_match: A peace overture toward Venezuela or Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says Russia is trying to come into Cuba with new submarines and a nuclear base, and recalls warning about watching in the middle of the night and seeing trafficking.
mentions.quote: Russia with new subs, nuclear base, trying to come into Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian submarine or nuclear facility established in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None established. A named country and a named facility type.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord gives them major events to come with dragons and water, and that it looked like a Chinese dragon.
mentions.quote: it looked like a Chinese dragon
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim on its own: the dragon and water imagery, uninterpreted here.

mentions.claim_text: He describes pillars throughout the United States and around the world like Azusa Street revivals, in multiple places rather than one in California.
mentions.quote: these pillars and they were like Azusa street revivals
mentions.falsify_match: Multiple simultaneous revival centres comparable to Azusa Street.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The comparison sets a recognisable scale.
